phases.name: Safe automation now
capabilities: Workflow abandonment nudges (quote pending, visit pending, activation pending)
Escalation ladders via NotificationOrchestrator (T+1d, T+3d, T+7d)
Today/Command Centre auto-prioritisation and one-click continuation
Duplicate maintenance report detection (recommend merge/dismiss)
Contractor profile missing-field prompts and readiness score
Tenant/contractor onboarding reminder sequences (extend existing jobs)
SLA-at-risk surfacing on contractor dashboard metrics (already partial)
prerequisites: WO workflow timer collection or metadata fields
success_metrics: Median time from assign → first contractor action down 20%

phases.name: Assisted automation
capabilities: Evidence review queue prioritisation
Document classification draft + wrong-document warnings
Compliance remediation plan drafts (grouped gaps)
Reassignment suggestions on stalled/deadlocked jobs
Risk-signal issue suggestions (SUGGEST_ONLY tier expansion with audit)
Rent reminder sequencing optimisation
Admin unresolved queue prioritisation
success_metrics: Landlord reassignment time on stalled jobs down

phases.name: Semi-autonomous operations
capabilities: Contractor ranking for assignment (recommend only)
Predictive risk escalation (recurring maintenance patterns)
Contractor performance decay alerts
Auto-renewal workflow drafts for compliance requirements
Cross-surface hidden-debt detection in Command Centre
prerequisites: Event bus or workflow timer platform
success_metrics: Repeat issue rate down on flagged properties

phases.name: Advanced automation
capabilities: End-to-end compliance remediation orchestration (user approval at each gate)
Semi-autonomous contractor matching with landlord one-click confirm
Predictive compliance bottleneck forecasting
Self-healing workflow recovery (detect drift, propose fix)
success_metrics: Support ticket volume per active landlord down 30%

recommended_first_programme.rationale: Builds on VERIFIED_OPERATIONALLY quote/visit workflow, existing NotificationOrchestrator, and Today projection. Highest ROI, lowest authority risk.
deliverables: Scheduled reconciliation job (suppress nudges if state advanced)
Today priority boost for stalled workflow items
Audit + idempotency for each nudge send
